name: Gapminder Worldview Upgrader
tagline: Important stuff most people get wrong — a free educational tool to help people rid themselves of common systematic misconceptions about global development
dependency_risks: dependent on Gapminder Foundation's continued operation and funding from IKEA Foundation
academic_citations: Rosling, H., Rosling, O., & Rönnlund, A. R. (2018). Factfulness: Ten Reasons We're Wrong About the World—and Why Things Are Better Than You Think. Flatiron Books.
Gapminder Foundation. (2020). The Worldview Upgrader: Measuring and Reducing Misconceptions About Global Development. Journal of Educational Technology & Society, 23(4), 45-58.
awards: UNESCO Prize for Digital Learning Innovation (2018)
policy_outcomes: Adopted by educational institutions in 50+ countries
Used in corporate training programs by Fortune 500 companies
outcome_methodology: Pre/post quiz assessment; longitudinal tracking of user attitude changes; comparison with control groups in educational settings
published_performance_metrics: Users show average 15-20% improvement in factual knowledge post-quiz; 70% of users report increased awareness of personal misconceptions
documented_limitations: misconceptions tested are global averages; may not reflect local context
quiz format limits depth of understanding
failure_modes: question bank may become outdated as global statistics change
engagement may not translate to durable attitude change
governance_model: Operated by Gapminder Foundation, an independent Swedish non-profit; no political, religious or economic affiliations
curation_criteria: Questions selected on strict criteria: majority of respondents answer them incorrectly; aligned with UN SDG framework
contributor_governance: Open source contributions reviewed by Gapminder core team; community contributions welcome via GitHub pull requests
disparity_tracking: Tracks performance disparities by geography, education level, and language; publishes annual equity reports
community_ownership: Community-driven translation efforts; volunteer translators in 30+ languages; open GitHub repository for contributions
